args.text:
US MARCH 2026 REVENUE BY STREAM — CFO REQUEST
Prepared by: david.murguia@gmail.com | Date: 2026-04-03 | Entity: Halvard Systems Inc. (US, USD)
READ-ONLY: no journal entries, reversals, matches, or checklist changes were made.

=====================================================================
1. SUMMARY — US MARCH 2026 REVENUE
=====================================================================
Stream                         GL     March 2026 (USD)
Subscription revenue           4000         52,300.00
Usage revenue                  4100            977.00
Professional services revenue  4200          7,500.00
                                       --------------
TOTAL US MARCH 2026 REVENUE                 60,777.00

Each stream figure equals the GL period activity (credit balance shown
positive) per get_account_balance for entity US, period 2026-03.

=====================================================================
2. TRAIL — EVERY LEDGER ENTRY BEHIND EACH NUMBER
=====================================================================

SUBSCRIPTION REVENUE (GL 4000) — 52,300.00
 JE-00222  03-01  INV-2111 Acme Logistics    18,000.00   DOC-0142
 JE-00224  03-01  INV-2113 Corvid Retail     11,500.00   DOC-0149
 JE-00219  03-01  INV-2115 Fairview Labs      9,400.00   DOC-0150
 JE-00215  03-01  INV-2112 Beacon Health      8,000.00   DOC-0153
 JE-00225  03-01  INV-2114 Evergreen Bank     6,200.00   DOC-0148
   Gross recurring billings                  53,100.00
 JE-00275  03-20  CM-0031 Beacon Health SLA    (800.00)  DOC-0192
   Net subscription revenue                  52,300.00

USAGE REVENUE (GL 4100) — 977.00
 JE-00236  03-04  INV-2180 Acme Logistics       977.00   DOC-0164
   (API usage overage, February 2026 service period, billed in arrears)

PROFESSIONAL SERVICES REVENUE (GL 4200) — 7,500.00
 JE-00255  03-10  INV-2118 Fairview Labs      7,500.00   DOC-0180
   (Implementation services, March 2026)

All seven entries are source = "ar", status = "posted", posted by
"billing", and every one carries support (has_support = true). There
are no unsupported revenue entries this period.

=====================================================================
3. COMPLETENESS AND ACCURACY PROCEDURES PERFORMED
=====================================================================
a) Population check. Scanned all 13 AR-side (GL 1100) entries for
   US March. They comprise exactly the 7 revenue entries above plus 6
   cash receipts (JE-00271, -00272, -00276, -00289, -00290 and related,
   all Cash 1000 / AR 1100 only, no P&L impact). No revenue was booked
   through any other account.

b) No revenue parked off-stream. Deferred Revenue (2200), Unbilled
   Receivables / Contract Asset (1300), Suspense (2900) and Unapplied
   Cash (2950) all show ZERO March activity and ZERO ending balance.
   Intercompany Management Fee Income (4800) is also nil, so no
   intercompany income is commingled in the figures above.

c) Customer coverage. All five recurring customers (Acme, Beacon,
   Corvid, Evergreen, Fairview) were invoiced in March, same as
   January (INV-2101–2105) and February (INV-2106–2110). No missing
   subscription invoice.

d) Roll-forward proof to cumulative balances:
   4000: 53,100 x 3 months less 800 credit = 158,500 = GL ending bal.
   4100: 612 (Jan) + 844 (Feb) + 977 (Mar) = 2,433 = GL ending bal.
   4200: 7,500 x 3 months = 22,500 = GL ending bal.
   All three roll forwards tie exactly.

e) Potential duplicate cleared. Two invoices both reference an Acme
   "February 2026" API overage: INV-2120 (DOC-0090, 02-03, USD 844)
   and INV-2180 (DOC-0164, 03-04, USD 977). These are NOT duplicates —
   different amounts, and each month carries exactly one arrears usage
   invoice. INV-2120's description is mislabeled (it is January usage);
   this is a description defect only, with no dollar effect on March.

=====================================================================
4. OBSERVATIONS FOR THE CFO (no dollar adjustment proposed)
=====================================================================
1. Usage revenue is billed one month in arrears. The 977.00 in the
   March P&L is FEBRUARY service-period usage; March usage will land
   in April. The convention is applied consistently across Jan/Feb/Mar,
   so month-over-month trending is valid, but the March usage number
   is not March consumption. Worth stating if this goes in a board deck.

2. The 800.00 Beacon Health SLA credit (CM-0031) relates to a February
   incident but was issued and booked on 2026-03-20, reducing MARCH
   subscription revenue. Arguably it belonged in February. The amount
   is immaterial (1.3% of the stream) and I have left it as posted, but
   flagging it because it is the sole reason subscription revenue dips
   from 53,100 in Jan/Feb to 52,300 in March — underlying recurring
   billings are flat at 53,100.

3. Open checklist item. "Revenue recognition" (US, assigned to the
   revenue accountant) is still OPEN for 2026-03. The figures above are
   the ledger AS IT CURRENTLY STANDS. They are internally consistent and
   fully supported, but they should be treated as preliminary until that
   item is signed off, in case the revenue accountant has further
   entries to post.

No exceptions were logged: every March revenue entry is supported and
nothing required a forced reconciliation.
